description:

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. title: Head of Operational Integration
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

About the Role

The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project.

  • Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost.

  • Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements, flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project.

  • Develop system architectures and conceptual designs, perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces).

  • Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans, and drive them through to completion with the teams involved.

  • Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot.

  • Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models.

  • Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs.

  • Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams.

  • Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments.

  • Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints).

  • Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap.

  • Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation.

  • Make sure models stay reliable through every deployment stage from PoCs and field tests to production, including changes in lighting, loads and sites.

  • Optimize models for embedded hardware to meet latency and compute constraints while maintaining the output quality.

  • Set up standardized evaluation and regression testing so that every model release is measurably better.

  • Build internal tools to visualize and debug sensor data, predictions and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering focused on computer vision or 3D perception, ideally in robotics or autonomous systems.

  • Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent).

Depuis son lancement en 2018, Swile a révolutionné le marché des avantages salariés.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Director of Sales, Club & Grocery
description:
About Bobbie

Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust.

But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again.

That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining.

Bobbie for Change

Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.

Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.


Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be one of the first QA hires in the UK, working alongside our UK QA Lead to build how we do quality here: frameworks, standards and process, with no legacy test debt to dig out of. Everybody here is hands-on, and that's what this role is: in the detail, every day.

Before anything we build reaches a pharmacist's queue in the US, someone has to decide it's ready. That's you. If you take pride in what ships, and you'll say "this isn't ready" even when everyone wants it out the door, you'll fit right in.

We've built an AI operating system for pharmacies, tackling the operational infrastructure behind things like paperwork and care coordination. It's in production with enterprise health systems

title: Finance Associate
description:
Finance Associate

Edinburgh | Full-time

 

Wordsmith

Legal touches everything that matters in a business: every deal, every hire, every launch, every risk. Sales runs on Salesforce. Engineering runs on GitHub. In-house legal runs on inboxes, chat threads and tools that weren’t built for it.
Wordsmith is changing that. We’re building the platform in-house legal runs on.

Requests from across the business come in through one front door. AI agents handle the routine work. Lawyers stay in control where judgment matters. Legal finally gets to triage by risk, not by whoever shouted loudest.

We’re built for in-house teams, not law firms. Our customers want to spend less on outside counsel, not more, and we’re on their side of that equation.

More than 500 companies run on Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Canva, Trip.com, Revolut, Adyen, Trustpilot, and Sage. We’ve raised $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, and we’re growing fast.

This role is based in our office in Edinburgh.

 

Why this role is different

You won’t be joining a big, process-heavy finance function. You’ll be one of the founding Finance hires, working on a brand new, AI-native ERP system (Rillet) with the freedom to actually improve how things are done — not just keep the lights on.


If you want real exposure to the business, a seat close to the founders and leadership team, and the chance to shape processes rather than inherit them, this is that seat.

title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

  Answering a high volume of inbound calls.  
 
 
  Offering thoughtful guidance as families consider the right time to say goodbye.  
 
 
  Being a trusted guide throughout the arrangement process.  
 
 
  Navigating multiple online systems with speed and accuracy.

description:
Headquarters:  San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
 

 In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it. 
 Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear. 
 At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better.

 We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market, communicate their value, and make sure customers discover and use what we're building.

title: Data Strategy Operations Manager
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - USA
 

 About the Role 
 As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs. 
 Who you are 
 
 Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand 
 Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo 
 Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale 
 Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations 
 Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment 
 A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way 
 
 What you will do 
 
 Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems 
 Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence 
 Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership 
 Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows 
 Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement 
 Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate 
 Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage 
 Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking 
 Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards 
 Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes 
 
 Must Haves 
 
 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

title: Terrain Following and Collision Avoidance Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that need to fly close to the ground, over varied terrain and through cluttered environments such as forests and built-up areas, where there is very little margin for error.

Even a carefully prepared flight plan must be backed by onboard sensing, ready to react to terrain variations and unexpected obstacles. We are building this capability and exploring hybrid approaches that combine planning and real-time reaction.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore, develop and evaluate terrain-following and collision-avoidance methods based primarily on onboard sensors, enabling safe low-altitude flight.

description:

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that rely on robust state estimation and sensor fusion to operate in complex, dynamic environments. Our platforms integrate multiple sensors (e.g., IMU, GNSS, vision, barometer, magnetometer) and require accurate, real-time estimation of system states (position, velocity, attitude, etc).

Classical approaches such as Kalman filtering are powerful but rely on modeling assumptions that often break down in real-world conditions. To push performance beyond these limits, we are exploring hybrid approaches that combine model-based estimation with modern machine learning techniques.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore and apply machine learning-based sensor fusion and state estimation methods to improve performance in dynamic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing ML methods for state estimation and sensor fusion.

Als MaKo Specialist Forderungsmanagement bei SpotmyEnergy sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Forderungen gegenüber Netzbetreibern vollständig, korrekt und fristgerecht abgerechnet und realisiert werden. Im Fokus stehen die Abrechnung der Preisobergrenze (POG) im Messstellenbetrieb sowie Modul 1 und Modul 3 nach § 14a EnWG. Du baust diesen Bereich bei uns maßgeblich mit auf und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass unser Geschäftsmodell als Lieferant und wettbewerblicher Messstellenbetreiber wirtschaftlich stabil läuft.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des Forderungsmanagements gegenüber Verteilnetzbetreibern für POG-, Modul-1- und Modul-3-Forderungen
  • Abrechnung des Zählerrückversands gegenüber den Netzbetreibern
  • Erstellung, Prüfung und Versand von Abrechnungen sowie Abgleich der Zahlungseingänge und Zahlungsavise (INVOIC/REMADV)
  • Klärung von Abweichungen, Rechnungsablehnungen und Kürzungen in Abstimmung mit den Netzbetreibern
  • Mahnwesen und Eskalation offener Posten
  • Prüfung der abrechnungsrelevanten Stammdaten (MaLo/MeLo, Zeitscheiben, Konfigurationen) als Grundlage für korrekte Rechnungen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Billing, Finance, MaKo-Kolleg:innen sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Reporting zu offenen Forderungen und Klärfällen
  • Mitarbeit an der Automatisierung und Optimierung der Abrechnungs- und Forderungsprozesse

Dein Profil

  • Kaufmännische oder energiewirtschaftliche Ausbildung bzw. ein entsprechendes Studium
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Forderungsmanagement oder in der Abrechnung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in der Netznutzungs- oder MSB-Abrechnung
  • Kenntnisse der Marktkommunikation (INVOIC, REMADV, UTILMD, MSCONS) sowie der regulatorischen Grundlagen (MsbG, § 14a EnWG)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und großen Datenmengen
  • Strukturierte, hartnäckige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran,

title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi

Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).

Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.

Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.

description:
WHY this position is important

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

  • Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

  • A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

  • Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat.

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines.

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consume

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

title: Technischer Systemplaner Elektrotechnik (m/w/d)
description:
Du bist der, den alle fragen beantwortet
In jedem Projekt kommt der Moment, in dem jemand wissen will: Geht das so? Reicht der Hausanschluss? Was muss umgebaut werden? Was sagt der Netzbetreiber? Bei GALVANY bist du derjenige, der die Antwort hat. Aus dem Office, mit dem Wissen aus deinen Jahren auf der Baustelle.

Ein Fall aus deinem Alltag
Einfamilienhaus, Baujahr 1974, der Kunde will Wärmepumpe und Speicher. Du schaust dir die Fotos an, prüfst Hausanschluss, Zählerplatz und Verteilung, planst die nötigen Maßnahmen und klärst offene Fragen mit Netzbetreiber, Kollegen und Installationspartner. Wenn der Monteur losfährt, weiß er, was ihn erwartet. Das ist dein Verdienst.

 

Was du machst

  • Elektroanlagen in Ein- und Mehrfamilienhäusern bewerten und die passende Lösung planen

  • Netzanfragen und Hausanschlüsse vorbereiten mithilfe moderner KI Tools

  • Rückfragen von Kunden, Kollegen und Installationspartnern technisch klären

  • Arbeit und Prüfprotokolle unserer Installationspartner prüfen

  • Mit deiner Erfahrung unsere Standards besser machen

Was du mitbringst

  • Ausbildung im Elektrohandwerk und mehrere Jahre Praxis

  • Du kennst VDE-AR-N 4100 und DIN VDE 0100 aus dem Alltag

  • Du kannst Technik so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Elektriker sie verstehen

  • Lust, Neues zu lernen.

title: Senior Manager Strategic Projects – Finance & Operations (m/f/x)

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to join our Finance & Operations leadership and work directly with our CFO/COO: as their strategic sparring partner and as the person who owns the cross-functional projects that shape how rebuy runs, from ERP and system changes to margin work and new markets.

At rebuy, Finance and Operations are closely linked. Every device we buy, refurbish and sell moves through warehouses, systems and ledgers across several countries. When those processes fit together, we grow faster and waste less. We’re looking for someone who finds where they don’t fit yet and makes them work.

You think like a consultant and deliver like an operator. Sometimes that means preparing a board deck, challenging a business case or giving the CFO/COO a well-founded second opinion. Sometimes it means sitting with Logistics and Accounting to work out why a process breaks, then running the project that fixes it. You bring structure, keep projects on track and make sure decisions turn into measurable results. For the right person, this role is a stepping stone to a leadership position such as Head of Finance or Head of Operations.

Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! title: Head of Compliance Product
description:
We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.

Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.

You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

title: Chargé de facturation maintenance H/F
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

EDL (Édition et Développement de Logiciels) est un acteur français indépendant et leader des solutions informatiques pour les services d’imagerie médicale depuis 28 ans.
Nos solutions sont installées dans plus de 600 services médicaux et utilisées par plus de 15 000 professionnels de santé en France et en Europe.

Nous développons une suite logicielle complète couvrant la gestion des services de radiologie, la diffusion des images, la dictée numérique, la reconnaissance vocale, la médecine nucléaire, la téléradiologie et l'intégration de moteurs d’intelligence artificielle.
Notre expertise repose sur l’innovation, la proximité client et une forte capacité d’adaptation aux évolutions technologiques du secteur de la santé.

Mission principale

Au sein de l'équipe Administration & Finance France, le/la Chargé(e) de facturation maintenance assure la gestion et le suivi de la facturation des contrats de maintenance et des prestations associées.

Il/Elle veille à la fiabilité des données contractuelles et tarifaires, au respect des échéances de facturation et à la bonne transmission des éléments nécessaires à la comptabilisation et au suivi du chiffre d'affaires.

  • Créer et mettre à jour les données de facturation dans les outils de gestion.
  • Établir les factures initiales, les renouvellements et les éventuelles factures complémentaires.

title: GTM & Value Creation Lead
description:
About Hexa

Hexa builds and scales software companies alongside entrepreneurs. Since its launch as eFounders, Hexa has helped create companies including Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa Scale is a small-cap software investment firm deploying a €100 million fund. We take majority stakes in established B2B software companies and work directly with their founders to unlock their next stage of growth. We bring capital, but first and formemost operators who get involved in the daily work to build the fundamentals required to ignite a real Sscaling story: go-to-market, product, hiring and the systems needed.

Hexa Scale

Many software companies have a strong product and loyal customers but have yet to build a repeatable growth engine. Their next phase calls for more than optimising today’s funnel: they need to rethink how they find, win, serve and grow customers as AI changes both customer workflows and commercial execution. They need people who can test what works with their teams and turn the learning into a way of operating.

That is what we do at Hexa Scale. We invest in software companies with roughly €2–10 million in ARR and work alongside their founders after the investment. Our approach is hands-on, with go-to-market at the centre of the acceleration plan?

Mission

We’re looking for a Value Creation Manager with a strong GTM background to join the Hexa Scale team. You will assess growth opportunities and feasibility before an investment decision, then work across our portfolio with founders and their teams to remove growth bottlenecks. Your judgement will help the investment team test whether a company has strong, executable growth potential; your operating work will help turn that potential into results.

title: Junior Data Consultant
description:
Onze Missie

LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. 

  • Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. 

  • Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. 

  • Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. 

  • Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI.   

Team

Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes.

description:
adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue.

At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us.

Meet Your Team: Rewarded Solutions

Our Rewarded Solutions team develops the technology behind adjoe’s innovative rewarded engagement products that serve over 57 million daily mobile users.

The team’s tech stack consists of three major components: native Android and iOS SDKs written in Java/Kotlin and Swift handling complex engagement flows; widely customizable offerwall applications built with React TypeScript; and a highly performant Golang backend hosted on AWS that processes millions of events hourly. Our system matches each game with its ideal users, delivering rewards optimized for satisfaction through data processed via AWS Athena, Kafka, Spark, S3, and MySQL.

For team members, this means having state-of-the-art resources to build engaging rewarded ad experiences that seamlessly integrate into the world’s top apps while delivering exceptional results for advertisers and monetizers in this industry-leading technology.

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

title: Industrial Architect (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Industrial Architect (all genders), you will design the Microliner industrial system from a Manufacturing Engineering perspective. Reporting to the SVP Industrial, your first priority is the build concept for the first conforming prototype: how the aircraft will be assembled, integrated, inspected, tested, supplied, and controlled. You will evolve this concept across the subsequent conforming prototypes into the industrial architecture for VÆRIDION’s series Final Assembly Line and POA-ready production system. Working closely with the Structures Architect and the wider Engineering organisation, as well as the Head of Assembly, Quality, Supply Chain, and Procurement, you will ensure that product architecture and industrial architecture develop together and turn the aircraft design into an executable and scalable manufacturing system.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the industrial architecture and first conforming prototype build concept as your immediate priority, creating one integrated view of how the aircraft will be manufactured, assembled, integrated, inspected, tested, supplied, and completed.

  • Translate the aircraft design into the manufacturing bill of material, bill of process, work packages, build sequence, stations, inspection points, and test flow.

  • Work closely with the Structures Architect and wider Engineering organisation to define Manufacturing Engineering requirements and drive Design for Manufacture and Assembly, covering structural breakdown, major joins, installation sequence, access, interfaces, tolerances, tooling references, ergonomics, inspectability, repeatability, and production risk.

In parallel, you will build VÆRIDION’s assembly capability as part of the company’s transition towards its own EASA Part-21 Subpart G Production Organisation Approval (POA). Following the prototype phase, you will lead the establishment, ramp-up, and operation of the series Final Assembly Line.

title: AI Solutions Engineer

Waarom deze rol bestaat

De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen.

Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn.

Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft.

Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei.

Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope.

Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van.

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. title: Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Team Overview

Über Buena

Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. Mit über 90.000 verwalteten Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Hausverwaltungen sind wir in den letzten drei Jahren zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Über die Rolle

Jeden Monat derselbe Schreibtisch, dieselben Konten, derselbe Bestand. Und wenn dich dein nächster Buchhaltungsjob quer durch Deutschland führt?

Du bist Buena vor Ort. Du reist zu unseren bestehenden Hausverwaltungen und machst aus jeder einen Buena-Betrieb. Bei jedem Einsatz lernst du eine andere Stadt, ein neues Team und einen neuen Bestand kennen. Du steigst direkt in die WEG-Buchhaltung ein, buchst selbst in unserer KI-nativen Buena App und zeigst dem Team anhand seiner eigenen Fälle, wie es darin bucht und abrechnet. Sobald die Abläufe sitzen und das Team seinen Bestand eigenständig in der App führt, geht’s für dich zum nächsten Standort.

title: Senior SAP / ABAP Engineer

  • FI/CO domain leadership: Turn accounting reality into code: posting logic, payment terms and Skonto, open item management, account determination, tax codes.

title: Team Lead SDR (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt. Series A abgeschlossen. ARR 2025 vervierfacht. Über 2.000 Anwält*innen vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an.

In drei Jahren sind wir zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal Tech Unternehmen in Europa geworden – mit 90+ Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin und einem international verteilten Tech-Team. Der Markt ist da. Das Produkt wirkt. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Jetzt geht es darum, dieses Momentum in echte Marktbewegung zu übersetzen – und genau hier kommt diese Rolle ins Spiel.

Outbound ist bei JUPUS kein Nebenkanal. Es ist einer der zentralen Wachstumstreiber – und du wirst ihn anführen. Als Team Lead SDR hast du direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell JUPUS in den nächsten zwölf Monaten wächst.

 

Was dich erwartet

Du führst ein Team von 12–15 SDRs im operativen Alltag: coachen, Calls mithören, Feedback geben, Energie hochhalten.

Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, dass dein Team heute gute Meetings generiert. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus starken SDRs die nächsten starken Account Executives bei JUPUS zu entwickeln.

Dafür arbeitest du eng mit dem AE-Team zusammen, entwickelst deine SDRs gezielt in Richtung Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung im Sales Cycle übernehmen können.

Viele Calls. Viele Neins. Und dann die Meetings, die den Unterschied machen.

Du weißt, wie das ist – und genau deshalb kannst du dein Team durch schwierige Tage führen, besser machen und auf den nächsten Karriereschritt vorbereite

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineer

UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

title: AI Engineer

Growth at United Media

Are you looking master the latest AI tools, build agents, and put them to work on real business problems? Are you the person who gets things done and gets their hands dirty? If so, now is the time to apply for the AI Implementation role at Private Equity Insights.

You will join an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people working on one mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

  • Unlimted AI Tokens We are ready to invest in AI and will equip you with all the tools and accesses you need to create 1000x results
  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. Yo

title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager - Money
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It's no simple task, but it wouldn't be interesting if it was!

About the Role

Money is DoorDash's organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.

title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Growth Partnerships + New Audiences
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer

About the Team

The EMEA Consumer Strategy & Operations team drives efficient customer growth across Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to help consumers discover the best in their neighborhood and make ordering a trusted, valuable part of everyday life. We identify emerging customer needs and translate them into strategies that attract new customers, deepen engagement, and build lasting loyalty. Ultimately, we champion the consumer at every step—making Deliveroo and Wolt feel local, relevant, and delightful.

About the Role

In this role, you will work cross-functionally with business development, marketing, product, engineering, and design teams to drive growth across growth partnerships and under penetrated audience segments. You will identify, launch and develop growth partnerships across our EMEA markets to acquire and retain new customers.  You'll go deep on customer segmentation to identify the next segment of customers we need to win to angle change growth.

title: SAP Engineer
description:
TL;DR: We're looking for exceptional SAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. This role moves beyond just ABAP: you’ll develop software across the stack, design AI harnesses and agents, influence product direction, and work with customers.

Why Conduct

Today, no single person fully understands their ERP setup: decades of customisation, millions of lines of ABAP, and undocumented changes from thousands of consultants has led to spiralling complexity. As a result, projects take years and migrations costs hundreds of millions.

Conduct lets IT teams run faster. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more.

We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct. We value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we'll make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who We Hire

We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP dev

title: Data Protection Executive
description:
📍 Lincoln Hybrid – 2 days per week in our city centre office, with 3 days working from home

Passionate about all things data protection? Looking for a role where you can take real ownership of your work and put your knowledge into practice?

We're looking for a Data Protection Executive to join our Compliance team and help ensure we're doing the right thing when it comes to handling personal data across Goodlord.

With the volume of personal data flowing through our platform, tenant referencing and insurance services, there's plenty to keep you busy!

You'll take ownership of our day-to-day data protection activities, from managing data rights requests and maintaining our records to helping colleagues across the business navigate data protection queries with confidence.

There's a task-driven element to this role, so you'll need to enjoy getting into the detail and managing a busy workload. But it's not just about ticking boxes. You'll be naturally curious, confident asking questions and keen to understand how we can improve the way we do things.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Managing data rights requests, including subject access requests, deletions and objections, ensuring they're handled accurately and within legislative timeframes.

  • Providing practical data protection advice and guidance to colleagues across Goodlord, including our frontline Customer Support and Referencing teams.

  • Taking ownership of our Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), working with stakeholders across the business to ensure they're accurate and up to date.

title: Partner Marketing Manager
description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re looking for a Partner Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team.

This is a brand new role and our first dedicated Partner Marketing hire, so we're looking for someone who has already planned and delivered successful B2B co-marketing campaigns with external partners and is excited by the opportunity to build a partner marketing programme from the ground up!

Partnerships are already an important part of how we reach and win enterprise customers. Now we want to build a proper marketing engine around them – identifying where the biggest opportunities are, creating brilliant joint propositions and campaigns, and turning our partner network into a measurable source of pipeline and growth.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Marketing Manager, you’ll work closely with Partnerships and Sales to decide where we invest, build compelling co-marketing plans and then get stuck into delivering them.

What you'll be busy doing:

  • Building and owning our partner marketing strategy, including how we tier and prioritise partners

  • Developing joint value propositions and co-marketing plans that resonate with our shared customers

  • Planning and delivering campaigns across content, email, social, events and webinars

  • Supporting partnership and integration launches with the plans, campaigns and assets needed to make them successful

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena's engineering team is small, senior and AI-native, and it ships across several products at once. This role leads a large part of that team, as a partner to engineering leadership, and owns how it scales. You will own delivery, hiring and team health for your part, and make sure a fast-moving team keeps shipping well across areas that look nothing alike. This is a hands-on leadership seat with a senior team and a lot of firefighting, not a layer of process.

What You'll Do

  • You will lead a large part of the engineering team, owning their delivery, priorities and growth.

  • You will own hiring and planning for your part of the team, and keep raising the bar.

  • You will turn shifting priorities into a plan the team can execute, and make trade-offs visible to leadership.

title: Global People & Workplace Specialist (London)
description:
As a Global People & Workplace Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting payroll, benefits, and workplace experience for our global team, with a particular focus on our UK-based employees. You will work closely with the People Operations team and cross-functional partners, including Finance, to ensure accurate and timely payroll and benefits administration while also helping create a smooth, engaging, and well-supported workplace experience.

Reporting to the Senior Payroll & Benefits Analyst, you will be an integral member of the People Operations team and will support a broad range of high-priority operational initiatives. This role combines detail-oriented payroll and benefits administration with hands-on workplace and employee experience responsibilities, providing essential services that directly impact employees’ day-to-day experience.

This is a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end payroll operations in Workday and Deel, including monthly international payroll processing, timesheets, time-off administration, expense approvals, pension remittances, payroll reporting, and related reconciliations

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve payroll, benefits, HR, and workplace processes, procedures, controls, and documentation to support accuracy, efficiency, and scalability

  • Ensure compliance with applicable payroll and benefits regulations, including tax, pension, and other statutory requirements

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Our Purpose

 

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

About this role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to lead and evolve our performance marketing function across regions.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced performance marketer who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing deep expertise in paid acquisition and a strong understanding of full-funnel growth in a B2B SaaS environment.

You will act as the central connector between brand, regional marketing, partnerships, and our external performance agency, ensuring performance marketing not only drives demand, but also improves conversion and contributes directly to pipeline and revenue.

title: Supplier Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Many of the capabilities behind our products, and the experience our players get, come from third-party suppliers. As our Supplier Manager, you'll own a portfolio of those suppliers. You're the person they talk to, and the person Product turns to for what a supplier can do, how it's performing and what it costs.

You'll join our Supplier Management team in Core Experience, part of Product & Technology. The team is based in Stockholm and Malta, and this role sits in Malta or UK (Leeds). You'll work with Product every week, and regularly with Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and Finance. We operate in many regulated markets, so every supplier arrangement has to hold up in each of them. You'll run your portfolio independently and bring the bigger, more complex calls to your manager.

 

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Owning a portfolio of suppliers and being their day-to-day contact for commercial matters, issues and escalations

  • Tracking supplier performance together with the product department, running regular reviews and driving improvements with suppliers and internal teams

  • Negotiating pricing, renewals and contract changes, together with Procurement, Legal and Finance

  • Working with Product on requirements, integrations and changes, and bringing supplier insight and commercial input to their decisions

  • Keeping up to date with suppliers and alternatives, and recommending the best options from a supplier point of view

description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

Strategic Insights owns Zilch’s key commercial data products, including the operational P&L, the expected loan economics view of the business, ensuring the numbers behind critical decisions are accurate, reconciled and well understood.

Sitting at the intersection of Finance, Data and Product, the team connects performance across the business, tracks progress against strategic targets and turns data into actionable insights that help Zilch grow and improve profitability.

You will lead a small team responsible for driving cross-functional performance reviews, identifying opportunities through LTV and commercial analysis, and tackling Zilch’s most pressing business challenges. This includes supporting strategic product initiatives, solving complex problems alongside business owners and filling critical analytics gaps across the organisation.

You will own complex work streams end to end with a high degree of independence, lead and develop others, and influence decisions across multiple teams and senior leadership.
