Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Architecture skills
General Accountant - Accounts Payable
Acquisition Operations
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

title: Business Development Manager - New Customer Acquisition
description:
Build new relationships. Win new business. Drive growth.

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager – New Customer Acquisition to identify and win new customers across Europe.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who enjoys opening doors, understanding customer challenges and turning opportunities into long-term contractual relationships. You will own the new-business sales process from initial prospecting through negotiation and contract signature, working closely with Inside Sales and Customer Success to ensure a smooth transition once the customer comes on board.

What you'll do

  • Identify and develop new B2B customer opportunities through targeted prospecting, networking and outreach.

  • Build relationships with high-potential prospects and convert opportunities into new contract and SLA customers.

  • Understand customer needs and create compelling, value-based commercial solutions.

  • Manage the full new-business sales cycle, from discovery and proposal through negotiation and closing.

  • Build clear opportunity and close plans and maintain an accurate, disciplined CRM pipeline.

  • Work within pricing and contract governance requirements while moving opportunities forward effectively.

  • Partner with Inside Sales and Customer Success to ensure a strong handover and onboarding experience.

  • Monitor pipeline, conversion and contract wins to continuously improve sales effectiveness.

  • Bring market, competitor and customer insights back into the business to strengthen our commercial approach.

What you bring

  • Ideally 5+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, with a strong track record in new customer acquisition.

title: Stage – Assistant marketing digital & commercial – Voyages d’aventure
description:
D'abord, quelques mots sur nous

Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time.

Your Role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it.

This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work.

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it.

*This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required.

Als Creative Lead setzt du neue kreative Standards, holst neue Skillsets und Perspektiven ins Team und sorgst dafür, dass eure Arbeit den Unterschied macht – bei Kund:innen genauso wie bei renommierten Kreativ Wettbewerben.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.

As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise.

If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you.


About this role:
  • Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change
  • Evolve contact allocation (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions
  • Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs: profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on
  • Design and evolve our data layer for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention

  • Design and implement APIs and integrations that connect tools and data across teams and systems, with a focus on backend architecture, performance, and reliability
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of performant, accessible user interfaces to support internal teams and external users
  • Work with program management, satellite engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to understand mission design and implementation, program, and business processes, and translate them into intuitive, reliable software

  • Practical experience with Docker for containerization and deployment
  • Experience with backend architecture, API design, and database interactions

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
description:
At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.

About the role 

Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against.
 
We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.

What You'll Do
  • Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.
  • Train at scale. Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real.
  • Define what "good" means. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy.
  • Explore stronger priors. Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see.

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain that moves them from donation to resale is offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We run a B2B marketplace where resellers and stores buy clothing in bulk, and we build the AI systems that digitise the supply chain behind it.

Our buyers sell on eBay, Vinted, Depop, Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Shop, or run vintage stores from Brick Lane to Paris to New York. They source graded stock from wholesalers and rag houses across many countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise an item from a single photo.

We are now going well beyond vintage. Live sellers can sell almost anything, and there is an opportunity for Fleek to be the backend for B2B resale. We've now started onboarding customers alongside supply from Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year on year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others, and recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it.

title: Meridial – Senior Research Software Engineer – Image Processing
description:
About Meridial

Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system.

Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).

The technical challenge

Our imaging platform records the activity of neurons and synapses in the living brain. The scientific value of these recordings depends on converting raw images into reliable, quantitative data.

This is a demanding image processing problem. Fluorescence signals are faint, noisy and spatially overlapping; residual tissue motion and other imaging artefacts must be corrected; in addition to conventional planar frames, data may be acquired from arbitrarily shaped 3D regions or several depths at once; properties vary between signal types and experimental configurations; and the same cells and synapses must be reliably matched across imaging sessions spanning weeks. You will build a software package that addresses these challenges in two modes: real-time processing and visualisation, with latencies of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, that inform experimental decisions at the microscope, and offline pipelines that deliver maximum accuracy for scientific analysis and serve as the benchmark for the real-time methods.

The impact of this work is direct and visible: your software will be used at the microscope as experiments unfold, and your pipelines will generate the data underpinning new insights into how neural circuits function and how they change in disease.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you'll be doing

As part of Wolt's Platform department (Core Group), you'll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. 

As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you'll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.

Our humble expectations

You'll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:

  • A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers

title: Growth
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.

You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape h

title: Design Working Student / Intern
description:
Join SE3 as Design Working Student / Intern

Design the visuals that show the world what we build, and learn the craft alongside our Creative Director.

About SE3

SE3 builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our creative team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As our Design Working Student or Intern, you'll be one of the first members of our new creative team. You'll work directly with our Creative Director and turn our brand into the visuals we need every week: LinkedIn posts, event and trade-show material, presentations and web graphics. What you design goes live quickly and is seen by customers, partners and future colleagues.

We're flexible on the format. As a working student, you'll work up to 20 hours a week during the semester and more during semester breaks; as an intern, you'll join us full-time. We'd like you to start in January 2027 and will plan around your exams. Much of our work is for defence, so expect drones, field tests and trade shows rather than consumer apps.

title: Senior Embedded Development Engineer
description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as Senior Embedded Development Engineer

Own the electrical brain of our autonomous systems, from schematics to flight. Early team, deep tech, high impact.

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for skilled, hands-on engineers who're ready to bring these machines into the real world.

About the Role

As Senior Embedded Hardware Development Engineer, you’ll own the complete electrical design of our UAV compute, sensor and avionic systems. From architecture to component selection, from first schematic to flight test, you’ll be in charge of engineering the electronic and firmware backbone of our spatial intelligence systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and AI teams, but this is your domain, and you’ll be trusted to build it right.

 
 

What You’ll Work On

  • Architecture & Design: Translate top level goals into requirements, then schematics and detailed designs for sensors, compute and communication across our flying platforms

SE3 Labs Is Hiring A Senior Computer Vision Engineer - Perception

Join SE3 Labs as a Senior Computer Vision Engineer - Perception 🚀

Build the perception that enables SE3's autonomous systems to see and understand the world, testing your work on real missions.

About SE3

SE3 Labs specializes in developing spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We leverage 3D computer vision, state estimation, and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, determine their location, and operate reliably, even when GPS and other sensors are compromised.

Our work today has significant applications in defense. As we grow to a team of over 100 people, you have the opportunity to shape our Perception team, expand your responsibilities, and contribute to our ongoing expansion.

Our founding team's research has garnered more than 90,000 citations, reflecting our deep expertise. You'll collaborate closely with founders and engineers experienced in computer vision and autonomous systems, translating research into field-ready solutions.

About the Role

As a Senior Perception Engineer, you'll develop core components of SE3's perception stack, including object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation. Your work will be tested on recorded mission data and in field trials, with mentorship from perceived leads, founders, and autonomy engineers.

No prior career solely in computer vision? No problem! We value exceptional ability and a strong passion for the field above all.

Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

Du gehörst zu unseren ersten Einstellungen und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den neuen Skill, der unsere CI/CD 100x besser macht.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere AI-PaaS auf Hunderte Enterprise-Kunden skalieren und betreiben können.
  • Du steuerst Agents. Die Guidelines und die Governance, nach denen sie Terraform, Pipelines und Code bauen, entwickelst du selbst. So skalieren wir unsere Software Factory.
  • Wir treffen die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen der Plattform gemeinsam, unter deiner Führung.

title: Chief of Staff / Portfolio Managing Director (m/w/d)
description:
Mitarbeiter Nr. 1. Du startest als rechte Hand der beiden Gründer. Am Ende bist du CEO von zwei bis drei Unternehmen mit 50 bis 100 Mitarbeitenden und mehreren Millionen EBITDA. Der Weg dahin ist klar, das Tempo bestimmst du.

Über uns

BLNWRK ist Private Equity ohne Fonds. Wir kaufen profitable Mittelständler in Berlin und Ostdeutschland mit eigenem Kapital und behalten sie. Felix hat Arsipa auf rund 1.200 Mitarbeitende gebracht und 2024 an Warburg Pincus verkauft. Milan hat bei HomeToGo als Geschäftsführer die internationale Skalierung mitgeprägt. Zum Portfolio gehören heute BOB und Milek.

Deine Journey

  1. Chief of Staff. Du machst neue Deals mit Felix und Milan, von Sourcing über Due Diligence bis Closing. Du baust die Holdingstrukturen auf: Reporting, Finanzen, Governance. Du treibst die Value Creation in unseren Portfoliofirmen.

  2. Portfolio MD. Du übernimmst die Geschäftsführung der ersten Portfoliofirma, mit voller P&L-Verantwortung, eigenem Team und eigener Value-Creation-Agenda. Du beweist, dass es funktioniert.

  3. Portfolio CEO. Dann kommt die zweite Firma dazu und gegebenenfalls die dritte. Du verantwortest 2 bis 3 Unternehmen, 50 bis 100 Mitarbeitende und mehrere Millionen EBITDA.

Was du mitbringst

  • Einige Jahre in Strategieberatung, PE, Investment Banking oder einer Operations-Rolle

  • Du willst CEO werden und nicht in zwölf Jahren Partner

  • Du kannst GuV, Bilanz, Cashflow und LBO-Modell

  • Du nimmst ein Team im Betrieb mit, auch den Meister mit 30 Jahren Erfahrung

  • Hohes Tempo, volle Ownership

  • Berlin als Base, regelmäßig vor Ort in den Firmen

  • Fließendes Deutsch

Was wir bieten

  • Attraktives Package mit Erfolgsbeteiligung

  • Klarer Weg zum Portfolio CEO

  • Direkter Zu

title: Marketing Manager B2B (m/w/d) KI-Fokus, Lead-Gen, Content Erstellung
description:
Über Livello

Livello ist ein B2B-Tech-Startup aus Düsseldorf, das intelligente Kühlschränke und innovative Verkaufssysteme entwickelt. Dank smarter Sensorik erkennen die Geräte entnommene Produkte automatisch, verwalten Warenbestände in Echtzeit und rechnen Einkäufe selbstständig ab – ganz ohne Kassenpersonal. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen einen einfachen und schnellen Zugang zu gesundem Essen und anderen Dingen des täglichen Bedarfs zu ermöglichen – überall und zu jeder Zeit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Automatisierung & KI-gestützte Workflows: Du nutzt modernste Tools, um Content, Designs, Lead-Listen, Kampagnen, Website-, Social-Media-Inhalte und Marketingprozesse erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Erstellung und Steuerung von Kampagnen (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Website, E-Mail, etc) zur Neukundengewinnung

  • Performance: Du arbeitest mit GA4, Search Console und Pipedrive. Jede Woche weißt du, woher die Anfragen kamen und was sie gekostet haben, und du weißt, wie wir mehr bekommen.

  • Content Creation: Du produzierst Posts, Artikel, Grafiken, Flyer, Fotos und Video-Content.

  • Website & SEO: Du hältst unsere Websites fit und sorgst mit SEO und GEO dafür, dass uns jeder findet.

  • Messe-Management von A bis Z, von der Planung über den Standaufbau bis zur Nachbereitung.

  • Kooperationen: Du findest und überzeugst passende Partner, die uns helfen, unser Netzwerk zu vergrößern und Projekte umzusetzen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Online-Marketing im B2B

  • Du nutzt KI täglich, verstehst Prompts, Automationen, Agenten und informierst dich über neue Entwicklungen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch. Schwache Texte und Fehler erkennst du schnell.

  • Zahlen sind dein Werkzeug. GA4, Search Console, Google Ads

  • Hohe Designaffinität und ein Blick fürs Detail

  • Du kennst dich aus mit Tool

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Select UK&I
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging to

title: Strategic Account Executive, UK & Ireland — Video Production, Media and Games
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

The role

Higgsfield is opening enterprise sales in Europe. You will own revenue from companies that make video in the UK and Ireland: film and TV producers, VFX and post-production studios, broadcasters, music and sports media, and game publishers.

This is a new-business role. You find the accounts, run the deals and close them yourself.

What you will do

  • Win new enterprise customers. Source, run and close multimillion deals with studios, broadcasters, production groups and game publishers.

  • Sell to four types of customer.

    • Film and TV: production companies and studio groups.

    • VFX, animation and post-production studios.

    • Broadcasters, streamers, music and sports media: in-house production and promo teams.

    • Games: publishers and studios that produce trailers and marketing video.

  • Run complex deals. Work with producers, heads of production, VFX supervisors, technology, procurement, legal and security

User Acquisition Manager - Wizz
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates apps and mobile games with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz, alongside chart-topping games like Mob Control, Block Jam & more.

Team

You'll be working on Wizz, a flirting and dating app designed for Gen Z, with over 3 million monthly active users in the US, UK and 17 other countries. Wizz offers young people a fun, safe space to connect with like-minded peers through meaningful 1:1 conversations. As part of a high-performing team of 20, you'll help drive Wizz's growth and turn it into a global hit.

As a member of a high-performing team of 25, you'll collaborate to further scale and enhance Wizz, fostering a spirit of goodwill and creativity. As Wizz continues its dynamic growth and development, we are seeking an ambitious User Acquisition Manager.

Role

Voodoo is looking for a User Acquisition Manager to own user acquisition activities for Wizz. You will leverage your expertise and creativity to fuel Wizz's growth and scale it into a global phenomenon.

  • Plan and manage UA campaigns for Wizz

  • Analyze campaign performance, identify the most relevant signals, and increase Wizz's ROAS

  • Work closely with our Product and Creative teams to coordinate efforts and share feedback

  • Use our suite of internal growth tools and interface with our Tech team to continuously improve them

title: Stagiaire Data Analyst - Référentiel FINESS H/F
description:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe “Personnes morales” du domaine Annuaires, au sein de la Direction des Opérations (DOPS), chargée de la refonte du répertoire FINESS. La nouvelle version du référentiel est en service depuis juillet 2026 et les travaux de mise en qualité des données se poursuivent, notamment sur les données SIRENE et sur les informations relatives aux structures sanitaires et médico-sociales. Référentiel national essentiel à l’identification des établissements, FINESS contribue au pilotage de l’offre de soins, au financement et au contrôle des structures, à l’orientation des usagers et à l’interopérabilité des systèmes d’information en santé. Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe produit pluridisciplinaire organisée en méthode Scrum.

🎯 Missions principales

Analyse et fiabilisation des données

  • Analyser la qualité des données SIRENE présentes dans le référentiel FINESS et reprendre les travaux de la précédente campagne.

title: Investor Relations | Closing & Structuration
description:
Contrat : CDI - Temps plein

Lieu : Paris 2e (Opéra) - Télétravail partiel possible

Prise de poste : Début 2027

Rattachement : Direction du Pôle Revenu

L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder.

Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois.

En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance.

VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle :

1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal)

Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€).

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account

title: Business Development Representative - German Speaking
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

title: Data Migration Manager
description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

Description du poste :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le projet FORCE, porté par Airbus Opérations et financé par la DGAC. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité.

Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone.

Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, la Direction de la Recherche, du Doctorat, de l’Innovation et de l’Entrepreneuriat (DRDIE) définit et porte la stratégie scientifique, d’innovation et d’entrepreneuriat de l’école. Elle coordonne les moyens nécessaires à sa mise en œuvre, de la recherche amont à sa valorisation en innovations pour les filières industrielles, veille à leur adéquation avec les ambitions fixées et s’assure de la bonne exécution par les centres, qui contribuent à la dynamique collective.

Chez Vivlio, nous construisons l’alternative française et ouverte à Kindle et Kobo : des liseuses, des livres numériques et une solution complète qui permet aux libraires, enseignes et éditeurs de vendre la lecture numérique sous leur propre marque. description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The role

You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

title: Technical Operations Manager
description:
Role

We are hiring a Technical Operations Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of our industrial battery projects, from signed contract to commissioning and grid connection. This is a hands-on role in a fast-ramping environment. You will own execution day to day, coordinate internal and external stakeholders, set up the systems that make delivery repeatable, and push projects over the line.

 

What you will do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of our industrial battery storage projects, from the moment the customer signs to final commissioning and successful grid connection.

  • Develop our delivery strategy and scalable processes so we execute faster, more reliably, and with higher precision on every project.

  • Coordinate the full project setup and execution, aligning requirements, timelines, interfaces, and deliverables across all stakeholders.

  • Steer and manage our EPC partners to ensure high quality execution, on time delivery, and smooth on-site coordination.

  • Support the selection and onboarding of suppliers and contractors, helping us build a reliable partner ecosystem.

  • Help shape our team build up: together with the founders and leadership team, define which capabilities we build in house and where we partner, and contribute to attracting top talent to BEO

 

What we're looking for

  • 1–3 years of professional experience in a dynamic, high growth environment

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Role

We are hiring a BDR to build our pipeline in the German industrial Mittelstand. Every customer relationship at BEO starts with a conversation, and you are the one who starts it.

Together with our Account Executives, you own the top of our funnel: you find the industrials where a battery makes sense, reach the people who decide, and turn a cold contact into a qualified first meeting. We are growing to the next order of magnitude, and the pipeline you build is what gets us there. You learn how a deal at BEO works end to end, and when you are ready to run your own, you do. Top-of-market OTE from day one.

 

What you will do

We are growing our customer base incredibly quickly. You are the spearhead of this expansion.

  • Qualifying leads: Our BEO sales stack generates and scores leads automatically, and we keep pushing that automation further. You take what it delivers, check it, prioritize it, and decide who gets called first. This is the top of our funnel, and quality here decides how good everything after it is. The leads you call are yours.

  • Cold calling: Our outbound motion works, and you take it to the next level. You call companies every day, turn conversations into SQLs, and get the data your AE needs to close (energy bills, load profiles, grid connection, how they buy electricity today).

  • Continuous iteration: We have a playbook that works, but the market moves and so do our customers. You feed back what converts and where we fall short. When someone says no, you find out why and help us fix it. We are always looking for the next edge, and you are closest to the customer, so most of them will come fro

title: Data Scientist – Optimization & Control
description:
Role

You’ll improve and extend the decision logic behind our battery fleet. Our optimization already runs our batteries every day; now we want to make it sharper, more robust and ready for new use cases. Our batteries sit behind the meter at industrial sites, so every decision has to balance customer savings, grid constraints and market value under uncertainty. Our data scientists and quantitative researchers work as one team and often across each other's topics.

 

What you will do

The role covers two closely linked areas. You can work in either one and switch between them as priorities and your interests evolve:

  • Fleet optimization: Plan how each battery runs over the coming hours and days, combining customer savings, grid fee rules and market value within each site's limits. Forecasts of load, PV and prices are generated and fed into the plan, which has to stay robust to their uncertainty. You also measure how much value we actually capture.

  • On-site control: Make the plan work in reality. Within our local control system, you design the logic that executes the schedule at each site, reacts to deviations and falls back safely when data or devices fail, while hard limits such as grid capacity, feed-in restrictions and state of charge always hold.

 

Topics you'll work on

You join work that is already running and take ownership of topics as priorities require. These are the areas where we want to add strength:

  • Improving and extending our optimization models for sequential decision-making on time series, across custom

title: Quantitative Researcher – Short-Term Power Markets
description:
Role

You’ll take the flexibility of our battery fleet to the short-term power markets (Day-Ahead, Intraday) and develop the trading strategy behind it. Our trading is asset-backed. Every position is backed by real flexibility in our batteries, which sit behind the meter at industrial sites. Available flexibility depends on factory load, site limits and customer needs, and changes every hour.

Our data scientists optimize how each battery operates at its site. You focus on trading our fleet's flexibility in power markets. Both areas are closely linked, and our quantitative researchers and data scientists work as one team, often across each other's topics. We believe our edge will come from better use of data, new approaches and sharper predictions.

 

What you will do

  • Developing our trading strategies on Day-Ahead and Intraday, from research and backtesting to live operation.

  • Building and improving price forecasts for short-term markets and turning them into trading signals.

  • Bidding and trading the fleet's available flexibility under uncertainty and real operational constraints.

  • Managing risk: imbalance costs, execution quality and the trade-off between expected value and downside.

  • Measuring captured value against clear benchmarks and finding where we can do better.

  • Shaping how we access markets and expand to further markets and products as we grow.

  • Bringing models into production together with our engineers.

 

What we are looking for

title: Grid Manager
description:
Role

We are hiring a Grid Manager to get our batteries onto the grid. Every BEO project has a grid connection point, and you are taking care of this vital element.

Together with our Sales and Operations teams, you own everything between our projects and the power grid: you secure connection capacity, translate grid codes and regulation into solutions that work, and become the go-to counterpart for grid operators.

 

What you will do

Every battery we install needs a grid connection. You make sure it gets one, quickly and on good terms.

  • Grid connections: You own the grid connection process for our projects, from connection requests and capacity reservation to signed agreements with distribution system operators.

  • Technical concepts: You analyse connection conditions, technical connection rules (VDE-AR-N 4105/4110), and the regulatory framework and turn them into concepts. Together with our team you shape the design of the connection point: protection, metering, and certification.

  • Grid operator relationships: You build strong working relationships with grid operators and are the internal go-to for every grid question, from Sales to Operations.

  • Scalable processes: You build the processes and templates that let us connect faster with every project, keep track of regulatory changes, and represent BEO in industry associations.

 

What we're looking for

  • Up to 3 years of experience in grid connection, grid operat

title: Founding Talent Lead
description:
Role

We are hiring someone to build up and own our talent function end-to-end. Recruiting, developing and retaining the best people is absolutely fundamental to our success. It’s also one of the most fun parts of building.

Together with our founders, you will build and own the entire talent stack: we’ll start with sourcing and winning the best talent (including building a long-term talent pool that we can rely on as we scale), and then move into building performance reviews and people development.

We have come this far because we have the best people, and we will go further because we keep finding them. Your job is to make sure that the biggest constraint on our growth is never people.

 

What you will do

We are scaling incredibly fast across all functions. We are 25 people today and will be a multiple of that next year.

  • Winning talent: you find the best people for engineering, sales, and ops roles, build the channels that keep candidates coming, and help the team turn the right ones into hires. You’ll help us do whatever it takes to recruit the best talent (even if that is a creative signing present). You make sure our recruiting process is ultra fast and convincing. You define the steps, keep candidates moving fast, prepare the team for interviews, and make sure we do not lose people we wanted. When someone turns us down, you build the strategy to change their minds. Beyond immediate hiring needs, you’ll build a long-term talent network (feel free to host amazing events).

  • People development: we don’t really have a structured process for this today. We may never. You’ll work with us on defining the right approach for performance

title: Technical Product Manager – Local Control System
description:
Role

You’ll build our in-house local control system from scratch: the on-site controller hardware and the software that decides how each battery charges and discharges. You own the product across hardware and software, from the first design to a reliable system running across our fleet.

 

What you will do

You will work with a dedicated developer team, and closely with our data scientists and Operations team. Your responsibilities will be:

  • Define the local control software, including dispatch logic, control strategies, fallbacks and interfaces to batteries, meters and the central platform.

  • Enable our Operations team to bring new sites live through tooling, documentation and hands-on support.

  • Own the product backlog, prioritize requirements across Operations, grid operations and the central platform, and work with developers from specification through release.

  • Design a configuration schema that works across all sites without requiring site-specific logic.

  • Own field reliability, including edge device requirements, testing, safety, release management and fleet-wide updates.

  • Drive the integration of power plant controllers and protection devices, and own IT security and the software requirements for grid services prequalification.

 

What we are looking for

  • Experience with software that controls physical systems and being in a product role, ideally in energy (battery storage, PV, inverters, SCADA or similar). Having taken a p

title: SCADA Engineer
description:
Role

We are hiring a SCADA Engineer to own everything that connects our batteries. A BEO site only creates value once it talks to our optimization engine, the grid operator, and the market, and you are the one who makes it talk.

You are our internal owner for all SCADA topics and responsible for the data and communication commissioning of our storage systems: from the field level to the cloud, from the first concept until the site is live and monitored. We are growing to the next order of magnitude, and the standards you set decide how fast every new site goes live.

 

What you will do

We are connecting more batteries every month. You make sure each one is online, reliable, and secure from day one.

  • Architecture and standards: You define the SCADA and system architecture of our sites, from inverters and meters up to the cloud. You set the requirements together with our Product Team, select the components, and turn what works into a standard for every project.

  • Commissioning: You plan and run the data and communication commissioning of our batteries, including all interfaces for monitoring, maintenance, trading, and the grid operator. When needed, you are on site (occasional travel within Germany), and you stay on it until the site runs stable.

  • Control and security: You help shape the control concept of our sites and make sure everything we connect meets regulatory and cyber security requirements. Along the way, you coordinate suppliers, integrators, and grid operators.

 

What we're looking for

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role

You’ll build the backend that powers our battery fleet: the services and APIs at the heart of our platform and the control plane of our own fleet management system across all sites. You will work in an interdisciplinary team where software engineers, data scientists and quants build together.

 

What you will do

The role covers two linked areas. You will own at least one of them, and we welcome people who want to work across both:

  • Core: Design and build the Python services and APIs at the center of our platform, used by our optimization engine, internal tools and customer products. You own their architecture, scalability, security and code quality. You also contribute to the customer-facing web applications built on these services.

  • Fleet Management System: Build the backend that manages our fleet: site and device configuration, getting schedules and commands to each site, and tracking what every site is actually doing. You make sure the right instructions reach the right battery reliably and securely, even when connections or devices fail.

You will own the backend that our optimization runs on. Your tasks include:

  • Design and build backend services and APIs in Python that connect batteries, our optimization engine and our products.

  • Own service architecture and make it scale as we grow from pilot sites to thousands of connected battery systems.

  • Build security: authentication and authorization, secure APIs, secrets management and safe access to devices on site.

title: Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Du baust als erste CRM-Person das Retention-Ressort einer Supplement-Marke mit über 200.000 Kund:innen auf — von null, mit eigenem Budget und Tool-Stack.

Über 200.000 Menschen haben bei Wehle Sports, eine Marke der Supplement Hub Gruppe, schon bestellt. Die Marke wächst im Direktgeschäft um rund 60 % pro Jahr — getragen vor allem von der Neukundengewinnung. Was nach dem ersten Kauf passiert, wurde bisher über Agenturen gesteuert. Genau dort liegt der nächste große Hebel: Die ersten 90 Tage nach dem Erstkauf entscheiden, ob aus Kund:innen Stammkund:innen werden.

Dafür gibt es diese Rolle. Du bist die erste CRM-Person im Haus und baust das Ressort von null auf: Lifecycle-Flows, E-Mail, SMS und WhatsApp, ein Loyalty-Programm, das bestehende Abo. Wehle Sports soll im DTC wachsen — CRM ist dafür neben der Neukundengewinnung der zweite große Hebel.

Und du baust nicht nur für eine Marke. Die Supplement Hub Gruppe vereint sieben Marken mit über 500 Produkten und rund 50–60 Mio. € Umsatz. Was bei Wehle funktioniert, wird zum Playbook für die ganze Gruppe — und aus der ersten CRM-Rolle wird in zwei bis drei Jahren die Leitung eines gruppenweiten CRM-Teams.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Wehle Sports ist über starke Produkte und Neukundengewinnung groß geworden. E-Mail, SMS und ein Abo-Programm gibt es — aber es gibt kein CRM-Team, keinen eigenen Tool-Stack über Klaviyo hinaus und keine durchgängige Logik, die Erstkäufer:innen systematisch zum zweiten und dritten Kauf führt. Bisher lag das bei Agenturen.

Das ändert sich jetzt. Das DTC-Team wird gerade neu aufgebaut. Retention soll so schnell wie sinnvoll ins Haus, eine Agentur bleibt nur dort, wo sie nachweislich mehr bringt. Dafür braucht es jemanden, der kein fertiges System verwaltet, sondern das erste baut.

Die Regeln dafür werden in Europa wie in den USA jedes Jahr strenger — und die meisten Unternehmen merken erst spät, dass ein Cookie-Banner keine Strategie ist. Genau an dieser Stelle arbeiten wir: Seit 2018 setzen wir Datenschutz technisch um, seit 2020 auch US-Privacy-Regulierung, in über 400 Projekten für mehr als 80 Kunden in 15 Ländern.

Du kannst Tracking? Dann lernst du bei uns, was in Deutschland kaum jemand kann. Spezialisten für Privacy Tech gibt es am Markt praktisch nicht — deshalb suchen wir niemanden, der es schon kann, sondern jemanden mit echter Measurement-Erfahrung, dem wir Consent und Privacy selbst beibringen. Ab Tag 1 betreust du eigene Kunden, baust Setups mit GA4, Google Tag Manager und Server-Side selbst und sprichst mit Anwält:innen genauso wie mit Entwickler:innen.

Wir sind neun Leute, wachsen seit Jahren organisch und bauen gerade unser Team in Hamburg auf. Wer hier überzeugt, übernimmt in ein bis zwei Jahren Verantwortung für das Consulting-Team.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Wir wachsen in beiden Bereichen — im Measurement und noch stärker in Privacy Tech. Im Measurement sind wir die unabhängige Messinstanz neben den Kampagnen-Agenturen unserer Kunden: Wer die Kampagne verkauft, sollte nicht auch das Reporting dazu liefern. In Privacy Tech gibt es kaum spezialisierte Agenturen; Aufträge landen sonst bei großen IT-Häusern, die das Thema nebenbei mitmachen.

Bisher hat unser Geschäftsführer das Consulting-Team allein geführt. Das stößt an Grenzen. Deshalb suchen wir eine Person, die heute als Senior Consultant einsteigt und morgen mitführen will — und die bewusst in Hamburg sitzt, damit wir hier mehr Team werden.

About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.

title: Referentin Business Continuity Management (BCM) / IT-Notfallmanagement (m/w/d)
description:
Standort: Düsseldorf | Vertrag: befristet (3 Jahre) | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

Mach Business Continuity Management für Hochschulen praktisch wirksam

HITS.nrw ist zentraler IT-Dienstleister für die öffentlichen Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Wir entwickeln moderne, sichere und leistungsfähige IT-Strukturen – damit Forschung, Lehre und Verwaltung zuverlässig funktionieren und sensible Daten geschützt sind.

SISB.nrw ist das Servicezentrum für Informationssicherheit und Business Continuity Management der Hochschulen in Nordrhein-Westfalen – gefördert von der Digitalen Hochschule NRW (DH.NRW) und dem Ministerium für Kultur und Wissenschaft NRW (MKW), organisatorisch angebunden an HITS.nrw. Als landesweites Kompetenzzentrum unterstützen wir Hochschulen und Schwerpunktrechenzentren als Partner auf Augenhöhe – mit Beratung, gemeinsamen Standards und Lösungen sowie hochschulübergreifendem Austausch.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du die Einrichtungen beim operativen Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Business Continuity Management. Im Mittelpunkt stehen das GRC-Tool mit Schwerpunkt BCM, Business Impact Analysen, Wiederherstellungsstrategien, Notfallübungen und Lessons Learned.

Was dich erwartet

  • Beratung und Begleitung der Hochschulen bei der Einführung und Nutzung des GRC-Tools mit Schwerpunkt BCM.
  • Fachliche Beratung zu Business Impact Analysen (BIA), Wiederherstellungsstrategie, (IT-) Notfallmanagement und Notbetrieb.
  • Mitarbeit in (BCM-)Arbeitsgruppen sowie ggf. Leitung eigener temporärer Arbeitsgruppen.
  • Durchführung von Abfragen und Auswertungen sowie strukturierte Aufbereitung der Ergebnisse.
  • Unterstützung der Hochschulen und Schwerpunktrechenzentren bei der Durchführung von Notfallübungen.
  • Organisatorische Unterstützung bei der Nachbereitung von Vorfällen und Erstellung von Lessons Learned.

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

title: Quality Control Technician – Semiconductor (m/f/d)
description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us to build up one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. 
As a Quality Control Technician you serve as the final quality gate before our products reach global customers.  
In this role, you combine automated optical inspection (AVI), systematic defect review, and final documentation checks in a cutting-edge cleanroom facility. During your onboarding starting in February 2027, you will complete a 6-month training program in Taiwan to gain hands-on fab experience, master core inspection procedures, and build a strong international network.

  • Validate outgoing wafer documentation and ensure strict compliance with quality, handling, and shipping standards.
  • Execute cleanroom environmental monitoring and support routine tool calibration and 6S audit processes.
  • Conduct initial troubleshooting on inspection equipment and execute lot disposition according to standard procedures.
  • Manage operational inventory of cleanroom parts, consumables, and Front Opening Shipping Boxes.
  • Handle manual packing and safe dispatch preparation of finished goods for warehouse transfer.
  • Work in rotating shift schedules (initially a 2-shift model, transitioning to a continuous 5-crew 3-shift roster).
