Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. As an MQR Technician at ESMC in Dresden, you play a central role in ensuring operational quality, accurate documentation, and process reliability. You bridge the gap between cleanroom operations, quality data analysis, and document management. In close collaboration with our engineering teams and international counterparts at TSMC HQ, you ensure that quality standards, offline calibration, and statistical process controls run smoothly from day one.


Job Responsibilities

  • Quality Data & Reporting: Support engineers by preparing preliminary reports, tracking SPC (Statistical Process Control) charts, and gathering data for Cpk and process health indices.
  • Document Control Management: Create, review, update, and archive quality- and production-related documents in compliance with international semiconductor standards.
  • Offline Calibration & Tool Management: Coordinate recalls, maintain calibration records, audit calibration status labels, and interface with external third-party calibration vendors.
  • Wafer Logistics & Cross-Fab Collaboration: Coordinate wafer shipments between ESMC and Taiwan fabs for qualification, testing, and quality defense.
  • Metrology & Tool Matching Support: Assist engineers with metrology tool gating, tool matching activities, and quality verification tasks.
  • Audit & Discrepancy Checks: Conduct regular checks on quality documents and system entries to detect and resolve discrepancies early.
  • Knowledge Transfer: Train junior team members and provide first-level support to internal users regarding the document management system.

title: Chemical Lab Technician – Semiconductor (m/f/d)
description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. As a Chemical Laboratory Technician, you will ensure the highest purity standards across our manufacturing processes. Working with state-of-the-art analytical equipment, you will analyze chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air impurities that directly safeguard our semiconductor yield. You bridge advanced trace analysis with active engineering support in a modern, 24/7 high-tech manufacturing environment.

  • Data Collection & Reporting: Evaluate test results, compile accurate data, and generate analytical quality reports for internal engineering teams and external partners.

  • Shift Collaboration: Ensure seamless 24/7 lab support by working within a rotating day/night shift schedule.

title: Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction & Novel View Synthesis
description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We’re seeking a Research Scientist to push the state of the art in 3D reconstruction. You should have command of the latest scene representations, such as Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and of reconstruction methods across the full range, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. We are looking for someone who knows the field well enough to choose the right representation and method for a problem, and then improve on it. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already done reconstruction research across more than one representation.

  • Design losses, priors, and optimization strategies that improve fidelity, robustness, and efficiency.

  • Build rigorous evaluations on public and internal benchmarks, and use them to drive decisions.

  • Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems.

About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

title: Business Development Lead (Enterprise DACH)
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to interact with their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

title: Hidden Gem (f/m/d)
description:
The role

Haven’t found the right open role, but believe you have the drive to take QD to the next level? This is your application. Great companies are built by curious people, and we’re looking for those who are excited about quantum technology, love solving problems and want to grow with a deep-tech company.

We’re expanding, and we know impactful innovation comes from diverse perspectives and skills. Whether your background is technical, operational, business-oriented or somewhere in between, we want to meet people who are motivated to contribute and shape the future with us.

 

Who we are

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds novel magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. We spun out of TU Munich in 2022. We use nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chips.

Nine of the world’s ten largest semiconductor manufacturers work with us, and our systems run in Europe, the US and Asia. We are investing €152 million in the world’s first production facility for quantum-based semiconductor inspection, in Munich, supported under the European Chips Act. Our international team of 80+ physicists, engineers and data scientists works side by side.

 

What you bring

  • Ownership: you take responsibility for your work, follow topics through to completion and care about outcomes.

  • Curiosity and a learning mindset: you ask questions and keep deepening your understanding of quantum technology and its applications.

title: Technical Support Engineer I
description:
Headquarters:  United States - East (Remote)
 

  Tines is the complete environment for enterprise AI, trusted by organizations like Reddit, SAP, Mars, Fin, and Headspace. Tines gives all teams a safe, scalable way to turn their expertise into software, whatever their technical background. 
 Since its founding in 2018, Tines has enabled over 600 enterprise customers to run their most important work, where reliability and security aren't optional. From IT and business operations to security and beyond, Tines empowers teams to build apps, agents and automations to solve complex problems and bring their ideas to life. 
 Founded by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella and co-headquartered in Dublin and Boston, Tines is truly agnostic and helps organizations bring their entire technology stack – any model, any tool, any system, any infrastructure – together. 
 At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.   A Technical Support Engineer provides technical support and consultation to customers and colleagues. They are essential in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, providing timely resolutions, and ensuring customer satisfaction. 
 This position focuses on responding to, owning, and resolving users' technical queries. 
  What you will be doing  
 
 Handling technical inquiries received across multiple channels (Slack, in-app chat, and email), maintaining high standards for responsiveness and ticket hygiene 
 Troubleshoot customer inquiries, including but not limited to API integrations, systems issues, network and security-related impediments, 3rd party integrations, and multi-product workflows 
 Resolve product or service problems by exploring the client's request, determining the cause of the problem, and selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem 
 Interpreting API documents and creating Tines workflows 
 Configuring and implementing authentication types like OAuth and JWT 
 Documenting the steps needed to connect to new tools or document any new workflows 
 Building, troubleshooting, documenting, and modifying workflows on remote sessions with customers 
 Building strong relationships with other team members within Support and the wider company, acting as the voice of the customer, and maintaining continuity with the team's priorities and open issues despite working outside standard team hours for part of the week 
 Contribute to Customer Support resources and deliver meaningful product feedback as the voice of the customer to leadership and relevant internal teams 
 Proactively identifying improvements to the product, bugs, and otherwise determining high-impact opportunities to enhance the customer experience 
 Writing clear, structured handover

title: Customer Reliability Engineer
description:

  Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.  Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications.   We encourage you to help us break that statistic!  
  About Tailscale   
 Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.     About the Role   
 If you're passionate about solving complex technical problems and helping build trust between customers and engineering, this is the role for you. We're seeking a motivated Customer Reliability Engineer to join our team. You'll take ownership of our most complex, ambiguous customer escalations, solving issues where the root cause is not always obvious. You will work these issues to resolution or alternatively a fully-documented handoff that engineering can act on without delay. 
 As a Customer Reliability Engineer, you'll partner closely with the Customer Success Team, Support Team, and Product/Engineering to close the gap between "customer has described a problem" and "engineering has what it needs to fix it." This role reports directly to the Customer Reliability Engineer Team Lead.

 Own high-severity, post-sales technical escalations from intake through resolution or engineering handoff. This includes deep-dive investigations and reproduction of difficult-to-isolate bugs. 
 Get on calls with customers, pull logs, and communicate with the customer about leading theories. 
 Build engineering handoff packages that require minimal follow-up questions: reproducible case, log evidence (timestamps, node IDs), version matrix, impact scope, what's already been ruled out, and a proposed engineering team to own the fix. 
 File and track issues for confirmed bugs, keeping the ticket/issue link intact so engineering retains full customer context. 
 Monitor for patterns across escalations to catch recurring or systemic issues early; translate what you learn into product improvements, tooling, and runbooks that raise the technical bar for the whole Support org. 
 Partner with Support, CSE, and Product/Eng, while staying within this team's scope. 
 
   What We Are Looking For   
 
 4+ years in a technical support or escalation role at a SaaS or infrastructure company, with demonstrated ownership of escalated/enterprise-tier accounts. 
 A genuine problem-solver who gets energy from untangling hard, ambiguous

title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
description:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

What you'll do

  • Map human motion onto humanoid kinematics and close the embodiment gap

  • Train manipulation and whole-body policies with imitation and reinforcement learning

  • Evaluate in Isaac Lab or MuJoCo and on our in-house humanoid, and measure the value of our data

  • Define what data training needs and help build our training setup, including GPU compute

  • Turn new research on robot foundation models and VLAs into prototypes

What you bring

  • Master's or PhD in robotics, CS, ML or similar, with hands-on experience from industry or research

  • Imitation or reinforcement learning on real robots (e.g. Diffusion Policy, ACT, PPO)

  • Strong Python and PyTorch; C++ is a plus

  • Physics simulation and sim-to-real transfer

  • Solid kinematics, dynamics and control

Nice to have

  • Learning from human data (egocentric video, motion capture, retargeting)

  • Humanoids, legged robots or exoskeletons; publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA or NeurIPS

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. What you have built matters more than a perfect match.

Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. title: Duales Studium Informatik (B. Sc.)
description:
Duales Studium Informatik (B.Sc.)

an der TH Rosenheim (m/w/d)

Starte deine IT-Karriere mit Studium und Praxis aus einer Hand.

description:
Senior Product Engineer

 

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

Möchtest du Gesundheitsfachkräfte auf dem Weg zu ihrem Traumjob in der
Schweiz begleiten? Bist du kommunikativ stark und sprichst fließend Deutsch?
Dann freuen wir uns darauf, mit dir ins Gespräch zu kommen.

Lies weiter und entdecke, ob diese Gelegenheit dein nächster Karriereschritt
sein könnte. Vielleicht wirst du schon bald unser neuer Kollege oder unsere neue
Kollegin.

Aufgaben

Was wirst du tun?

  • Während des Bewerbungsgesprächs informierst du den Kandidaten über die
    Möglichkeiten, die die Schweiz bietet, und besprichst ausführlich seine Wünsche
    und Erwartungen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Team wählst du die am besten passenden Auftraggeber für
    deine Kandidaten aus und stellst diese vor.

  • Du hältst regelmäßig Kontakt mit deinen Auftraggebern, um über ihre Wünsche
    und Bedürfnisse informiert zu bleiben.

  • Du baust eine Beziehung zu den Kandidaten auf, indem du sie sorgfältig im
    Auswanderungsprozess begleitest.

  • Du denkst mit über das Marketing und die Rekrutierung von Pflegefachkräften
    wie Physiotherapeuten, Ergotherapeuten und Pflegekräften.

  • Du schreibst Stellenanzeigen auf Deutsch, Englisch und Niederländisch.

  • Du besuchst Gesundheitseinrichtungen in der Schweiz, um bestehende
    Beziehungen zu pflegen.

Qualifikation

Was bringst du mit?

  • Keine Erfahrung erforderlich, du wirst gründlich eingearbeitet. Fehler
    machen ist erlaubt!

  • Aktive Arbeitseinstellung, du greifst gerne zum Telefon.

  • Geselligkeit: Interesse an Kollegen, Kunden und Kandidaten.

  • Fachhochschulniveau in Arbeits- und Denkniveau.

  • Wohnhaft in Groning

title: Leitung Content & Personal Branding (m/w/d)
description:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

title: Design Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Heartworking in Hannover. In Voll- oder Teilzeit. Hybrid.

Wir suchen jemanden, der/die Interfaces gestaltet und baut – und Verantwortung für das Produkt übernimmt, bis es im Browser genauso gut funktioniert wie in der Vorstellung. Tarifrechner, Kundenportale, Antragsflows, Konfiguratoren, Websites – Anwendungen, bei denen hunderttausende Menschen nicht merken sollen, wie komplex "das unter der Haube" ist. Die WordPress-Landingpage von der Stange gibt's woanders.

Aufgaben

So sieht dein Alltag aus

  • Du entwirfst und baust Interfaces – vom Konzept über den visuellen Entwurf bis in den funktionierenden Code. Du kannst ein Feature von der Idee bis in den Browser bringen, ohne es abgeben zu müssen. Das heißt nicht, dass du alles alleine machst – im Team arbeiten Entwickler:innen mit dir im selben Codebase. Aber du bist nicht abhängig davon, dass jemand anderes deinen Entwurf interpretiert.
  • Du arbeitest mit modernen Tools, die die Grenze zwischen Design und Code auflösen – Nordcraft, Cursor, v0 und was sonst in der Praxis taugt. Genauso selbstverständlich schreibst du eigenen Code, wenn das die bessere Lösung ist. Du evaluierst neue Ansätze mit Neugier, aber ohne Hype: nicht jedes Tool, das in der Community trendet, verdient deine Zeit.
  • Du baust und pflegst Design-Systeme dort, wo sie hingehören: im Code. Tokens, Komponenten, Varianten, Dokumentation – als lebendiges System, das direkt im Produkt funktioniert.

title: UX/UI-Designer:in | Konzeption & Design (w/m/d)
description:
Heartworking in Hannover. In Voll- oder Teilzeit. Hybrid.

Wir bauen digitale Plattformen für namhafte Kunden aus Versicherung, Energieversorgung, Industrie und weiteren Branchen: Tarifrechner, Kundenportale, Konfiguratoren, Antragsflows – Anwendungen, die hunderttausende Menschen nutzen.

Wenn am Ende niemand merkt, wie kompliziert das unter der Oberfläche war, haben wir unseren Job gemacht. Du bekommst bei uns das, was Agenturen selten bieten: einen Kunden, den du wirklich kennenlernen kannst. Unsere Kundenbeziehungen bestehen seit vielen Jahren, die meisten länger als zehn. Eher Produktmanagement als Projektgeschäft.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene UX/UI-Designer:in (w/m/d), die sich in Produkte einarbeitet, sie gestaltet und von der ersten Idee bis über den Go-Live hinaus Verantwortung übernimmt.

Alle willkommen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Herkünfte und Lebenswege.

Aufgaben

SO SIEHT DEIN ALLTAG AUS

  • Du verantwortest Konzeption und Interfaces deiner Projekte: von Research über Informationsarchitektur, User Flows und Wireframes bis zum fertigen UI-Design. Du wartest nicht auf ein Briefing, sondern stellst die richtigen Fragen – auch die unbequemen. Du denkst immer vom Nutzerbedürfnis her.
  • Qualität endet für dich nicht beim Entwurf: Du begleitest die Umsetzung bis ins Detail und bleibst auch nach dem Go-Live dran, wenn es um Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung geht.
  • Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Team (6–8 Personen aus Beratung, Projektmanagement, Design und Entwicklung) – direkt am Kunden. Du planst und moderierst Workshops, präsentierst Konzepte vor Stakeholdern und begründest Designentscheidungen. Design vertritt bei uns die Nutzer:innen – von Anfang an.
  • Du baust Design-Systeme: Komponenten, Varianten

title: UI/UX Designer mit Product-Design-Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld
description:
Über Cannaleo Digital

Wir gehören zu den führenden Softwareanbietern im Bereich Medizinal-Cannabis. Über 400 Apotheken nutzen bereits unsere Lösungen und mehr als 3 Millionen Bestellungen wurden über unsere Systeme verarbeitet. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte für Apotheken, Ärzt:innen, Großhändler und weitere Partner und gestalten damit die digitale Zukunft der Medizinal-Cannabis-Versorgung.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Gestaltung und Optimierung digitaler Produkte: Du entwickelst und optimierst moderne, intuitive und benutzerfreundliche Benutzeroberflächen für unsere digitalen Softwarelösungen im Bereich Medizinalcannabis. Dabei gestaltest du komplexe Funktionen und Prozesse so einfach und übersichtlich wie möglich und sorgst für ein ansprechendes Nutzererlebnis.

  • Entwicklung von Wireframes, Prototypen und Design-Systemen: Du erstellst Wireframes, interaktive Prototypen und hochwertige UI-Designs. Außerdem entwickelst und pflegst du unsere bestehende Figma-Library sowie unser Design-System weiter.

  • Gestaltung komplexer Software-Oberflächen und Workflows: Du konzipierst und gestaltest übersichtliche Dashboards, Tabellen, Filter, Formulare und digitale Workflows. Dabei hast du ein gutes Gespür dafür, komplexe Daten und Prozesse verständlich darzustellen und die täglichen Arbeitsabläufe von Arztpraxen und Apotheken durch intuitive digitale Lösungen zu vereinfachen.

  • Analyse von Nutzerbedürfnissen und User Experience: Du versetzt dich in die Perspektive unserer unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen, insbesondere Ärzt:innen, Apotheken und deren Mitarbeiter:innen. Du analysierst deren Bedürfnisse und Arbeitsabläufe und entwickelst daraus nutzerzentrierte Lösungen, die funktional, intuitiv und visuell ansprechend sind.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt TypeScript & SaaS-Plattform
description:
Gestalte die nächste Generation der Personaleinsatzplanung.

Wir von der IT Studio Rech GmbH suchen für unseren Kunden und Partner, die MEP24 Software GmbH, einen Senior Full-Stack Developer in Vollzeit.

MEP24 entwickelt Software, mit der Unternehmen ihre Mitarbeitenden passend einsetzen und ihren Arbeitsalltag besser organisieren. Seit 1996 bringt das Unternehmen Erfahrung aus der Personaleinsatzplanung mit. Heute vertrauen über 2.200 Kunden aus Apotheken, Kliniken und Handelsunternehmen auf MEP24.

Mit mina.works entwickelt MEP24 seine neue SaaS-Plattform auf einem modernen TypeScript-Stack weiter. Dafür suchen wir Dich: jemanden, der Frontend und Backend beherrscht, Architektur mitgestalten möchte und Verantwortung für durchdachte Software übernimmt. Du wirst Teil des Entwicklungsteams von MEP24 – wir begleiten die Suche und das Kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmanagement und Jens Gerstenecker, dem Geschäftsführer von MEP24, zusammen. Das Entwicklungsteam wächst – und Du gestaltest mit, wie Ihr zusammenarbeitet, technische Entscheidungen trefft und die Plattform weiterentwickelt.

Als Entwickler wirst Du…

  • Du entwickelst mina.works mit TypeScript, Node.js und React weiter – vom Backend bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen und entwickelst die Architektur der Plattform gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

  • Du arbeitest an verteilten Services und eventgetriebenen Abläufen mit Event Sourcing, CQRS und RabbitMQ.

  • Du entwickelst verständliche REST-APIs, arbeitest mit PostgreSQL und setzt Redis für Caching und Nachrichtenverarbeitung ein.

  • Du setzt fachliche Anforderungen in gut nutzbare Funktionen um und behältst dabei Wartbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und das Zusammenspiel der Services

title: HR Generalist (m/w/d)
description:
Personal-Management und Human Resources sind für dich eine Offenbarung? Du bist sozusagen ein Personal Jesus? Sing Hallelujah, denn: summarum sucht dich! Als Bürodienstleister nehmen wir Agenturen und Freelancern administrative Aufgaben ab. Dazu gehören auch das Vertragswesen, Bewerbermanagement, administrative Personalverwaltung und Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei Recruiting-Prozessen.

Aufgaben

Ein Arbeitstag bei summarum könnte also so aussehen:

Wuppertal-Elberfeld, 08:30 Uhr. Wenn du barmherzig lächelnd durch die Räumlichkeiten des summarum-Büros zu schweben scheinst, nennt dich dein Team hinter deinem Rücken „Heiland von HR“. Den Bewerber-Marathon für den Kunden in Düsseldorf hast du grad eben von „vor Ort“ in „digital“ verwandelt wie Wasser in Wein. Mit strenger Milde verfasst du als Nächstes das Zeugnis für eine Mitarbeiterin eines Kunden aus Hamburg. Die Ankunft des neuen Kollegen in Wuppertal hast du bereits vorbereitet:

Sein Arbeitsplatz erstrahlt wie ein Altar, sein Notebook ist bereit für großes Schaffen. Auch der Anwalt hält es für einen Segen, dass du HR Generalist (m/w/d) bei summarum bist. Jetzt noch etwas auf digitalen Pfaden wie Xing und LinkedIn wandeln und dann geht’s auch schon wieder heim zum Abendmahl.

Wenn du Lust auf verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben und ein Arbeitsumfeld hast, in dem Kunden und Team dein Know-how und dein Engagement zu schätzen wissen, bewirb dich jetzt!

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und ggf. eine Zusatzqualifikation im Personalbereich oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Headquarters:  Canada - Remote
 

 Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. 
 Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. 
 We're hiring  Technical Support Specialists  to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities. 
 You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't  how many cases you closed ; it's  how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen . 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
  Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases.  Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter. 
  Build and own AI quality.  Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain. 
  Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng.  Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work. 
 
 What success looks like in your first 6 months 
 
 Shipped 3–5 AI solutions 
 A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume 
 Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster 
 You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it. 
 You build with AI to make yourself  and the teammates around you  faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and  turning one-off builds into reusable pattern

title: Product Manager F/H
description:

  • Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

Most organisations make their biggest decisions on a thin slice of evidence - a handful of customer calls, one survey, instinct when the data runs out. Electric Twin changes that. description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

title: Welding Sales Manager
description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is America's largest manufacturer of AI-native industrial robots. Full-stack robots—hardware, software, and AI—all designed and assembled in Glen Cove, New York. The company makes AI-native robots anyone can buy and deploy, with customers ranging from family-owned machine shops to the Fortune 500. Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.

About the role

Fabricators across the country can't hire enough welders, and you know it better than most, because you've run a torch yourself. As our Welding Sales Manager, you'll show shops what cobot welding does for their throughput, quality, and people, and you'll own the national welding number. Welding is one of our fastest-growing applications, and you'll be the person who helps it grow even faster.

📍 Location

This role is remote within the United States, and we prefer candidates in NYC metro, North Carolina, California, Illinois or Texas. Expect to travel frequently to customer sites, regional teams, trade shows, and partners (~50% domestic travel).

What you'll do

- Own the welding number. You carry the national quota for welding systems and revenue across direct and partner sales. You build and manage the welding pipeline and forecast with each region, and you measure success by installed, producing systems, not just bookings.

- Partner with Regional Sales Managers. You co-sell welding opportunities with RSMs in every territory, from discovery through close. That means welding-specific discovery, part and joint reviews, and ROI conversations with fabricators. You'll join customer site visits, demos, and weld trials alongside our Welding Applications Engineers, and you'll raise the welding knowledge of the broader sales team through training, deal reviews, and ride-alongs.

- Sell direct MIG welding systems. You help shops evaluate cobot MIG welding against their part mix, volumes, and labor constraints, and you lead the proposals, pricing, and negotiation on welding deals.

- Build the partner channel. You recruit and manage gas and welding distributors as a lead source for Standard Bots welding. You also support partner-built solutions, such as laser welding cells, from the first conversation to repeatable sales.

- Be the voice of the welding customer. You bring field feedback on ease of use, features, and competitive gaps to the welding product team, and you represent Standard Bots at welding and fabrication trade shows and industry events.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on welding

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager       Are you skilled in driving meaningful engagement to achieve client success?       Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?       About our Team      Our Academic & Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research - turning insights into outcomes.      About the role      Customer Success Managers are the primary post-sales point of contact for customers. As such, they are responsible for onboarding, enablement, and value realization across Solutions and Research Sales portfolios and are expected to be fluent in all portfolio offerings. They work closely with Account Managers, Account Support, and other support functions to ensure strategic goals within the account are achieved. For certain product sets, they may coordinate with a technical onboarding team during implementation, after which they become the main point of contact through adoption, ongoing engagement, and renewal.     The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is focused on customer engagement, success, and satisfaction in adopting Elsevier solutions. The CSM serves as a trusted advisor to customers while protecting the existing revenue base and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. The primary role of a CSM is to drive value realization and effective use of solutions and products to ensure successful adoption, continuously improve customer satisfaction, and maximize customer outcomes. Their focus is on customer retention, renewal growth, and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, supported by trainer, implementation, and consulting functions.      Responsibilities        Build and Nurture Customer Relationships -  Establish trusted partnerships, identify and develop champions, facilitate feedback between customers and product teams, and address organizational requirements and queries.   Drive Customer Satisfaction & Success -  Deliver tailored value stories, demonstrate ROI, and reinforce the benefits of digital solutions to enhance customer engagement.   Support Retention & Renewal -  Collaborate with Sales to highlight value, address customer needs, and advocate for solution renewals.   Identify Cross-sell & Upsell Opportunities -  Analyze customer data and ambitions to uncover growth opportunities, adding value through personalized insights and experience.   Deliver Scalable Digital Training -  Conduct effective online and face-to-face training sessions, including product demos and workshops, aligned with customer needs.   Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration -  Share success stories, insights, and best practices across customer-facing teams and the broader organization

title: Customer Success Manager
description: About The Role   RPM is seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to engage directly with our valued enterprise software customers and help them get the most out of the products. This role will proactively talk with end users and license holders to help ensure the best possible experience using our software and working with our business. The Customer Success Manager will advocate for our customers and will work closely with RPM software sales, support, and consulting teams.  You will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our customers, ensuring they receive maximum value from our products and services. You will work closely with customers to understand their needs, provide solutions, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. This role requires a blend of customer service, account management and sales skills. You will have strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities for expansion within existing customers. You will play a crucial role in ensuring customer satisfaction, driving product adoption, and contributing to revenue growth.  This is a permanent full-time role based out of Calgary.  Key Responsibilities    Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned customers.  Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, issues, and escalations.  Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to assess customer satisfaction and product usage.  Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing customer base.  Collaborate with the sales team to develop strategies for expanding product adoption and usage.  Assist customers in the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition and effective product adoption.  Provide training and resources to help customers fully utilize our products and services.  Act as a customer advocate, understanding their needs and representing their interests within the company.  Gather and relay customer feedback to internal teams for product improvements and feature requests.  Work closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product, and support, to ensure a cohesive customer experience.  Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and provide timely updates.     About You   You will have:    Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.  Experience in software, mining or related industry.  3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or sales, preferably in a B2B environment.  Proven track record of driving customer satisfaction.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with customers.  Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing customer needs.  Ability to analyse data and generate insights to inform customer strategies.  Proficiency in CRM software and other relevant tools.  Legally entitled to work in Canada.     About RPM   RPMGlob

title: Key Account Manager
description: Bij KMWE op het BIC1 zijn we op zoek naar een nieuwe collega voor onze afdeling Sales. Als Key Accountmanager heb je een verantwoordelijke functie waarbij jouw communicatieve en organisatorische vaardigheden in zijn geheel tot zijn recht komen.     FUNCTIEOMSCHRIJVING     Als Key Accountmanager ben je onderdeel van ons Sales team waarbij je rapporteert aan de Business Manager met als thuisbasis onze locatie op het BIC1 in Eindhoven. Jij bent het strategische aanspreekpunt voor onze belangrijkste klanten. Je bouwt aan langdurige relaties, signaleert commerciële kansen en vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met interne afdelingen zoals inkoop, projectmanagement en productieteams waarbij je als spin in het web fungeert. Je bent een goede onderhandelaar waarbij je de klantrelaties en belangen van KMWE goed kan afwegen. Jouw focus zal liggen op het managen van grote accounts waarbij de nadruk ligt op het beheren en uitbouwen van de relatie met bestaande klanten. Je weet de relatie uit te diepen en bent een gesprekspartner op maat waarbij je vertrouwen creëert en afspraken opvolgt. Gesprekspartners bij de klanten zijn bijvoorbeeld inkopers, accountmanagers als ook technisch inhoudelijke stakeholders waarbij het van belang is dat je ook op technisch vlak begrijpt waar het over gaat. Om deze reden zijn we op zoek naar een collega die een technische achtergrond heeft qua opleiding of een sterke affiniteit heeft met high tech en snel materie eigen kan maken.     TAKEN EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN        Je bent eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze belangrijke klanten;    Je weet met de juiste mensen aan tafel inhoudelijke gesprekken te voeren;    Je zet het accountplan op en voert daarbij behorende strategische acties uit;    Je stelt offertes op;    Onderhandelen over kosten en planning;    Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften;    Je bent verantwoordelijkheid voor New Product Introductions (NPI);    Je volgt escalaties op in de productieomgeving;    Je communiceert met interne stakeholders over planning, escalaties en kosten.        FUNCTIE EISEN        Je hebt een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Technische bedrijfskunde of Werktuigbouwkunde;    Je hebt kennis van of een zeer sterke affiniteit met techniek;    Voor deze positie breng je minimaal 5 jaar in een soortgelijke rol of omgeving met je mee;    Bij voorkeur heb je ervaring opgedaan in een productieomgeving binnen een high tech omgeving, heb je ervaring binnen de semicon dan is dat een pre;    Je bent een betrouwbare gesprekspartner wat naar voren komt in jouw communicatieve vaardigheden;    Je bent volhardend, resultaatgericht en overtuigend;    Naast een sterke motivatie wil je ook graag een impact maken;    Je beschikt over uitstekende vaardigheden van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.        OVER KMWE PRECISION     KMWE biedt totaaloplossingen in engineering en assemblage van hoogwaardige modules en machinesysteme

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb.   • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bra

Über uns

Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, fester Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben.

Worum es geht

Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

The opportunity

Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits.

We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land.

No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet.

description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

title: DevOps - Senior Consultant
location: Hybrid - Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, London
description:
Ready to automate, innovate and make a real impact? 

Do you want to build reliable, scalable systems that make a real difference to millions of people? Do you want to work at a certified B Corp with an inclusive and learning culture as part of a diverse team of great people? 

If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. Working in DevOps, you’ll build and maintain the systems that let teams respond quickly to needs. You’llwork on high-impact projects, helping to build reliable, scalable systems. We align work to industry-recognised roles such as Build & Release Engineer (BRE), Platform Engineer (PLE) or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and, where needed, to more specialised areas such as security, cloud hosting, infrastructure or networking. 

What’s life like as a senior devops consultant at Opencast?

At Opencast, we love to keep things simple, and we love automation.

It’s not the same as your standard senior devops consultant job. Depending on your client’s needs, you’ll take on a range of roles. These will include:

  • Taking the lead on responding to outages, triaging issues, balancing stakeholder priorities/concerns, and keeping communication channels open with all parties.

  • Designing, developing, and implementing continuous deployment solutions that help our clients to deliver software faster and more efficiently.

  • Collaborating with our clients to understand their ways of working and will have an enthusiasm to learn new tools and technologies as needed.

  •  Helping and mentoring other developers so that they can achieve their full potential

Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

About the team
 

We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa.

Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on.

You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

title: Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map.

Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on.

title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

Over MyWheels

MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt.

Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij.

Wir sind der kompetente Problemlöser und zuverlässige Partner für erst klassige und effiziente Reinigungslösungen für professionelle Anwender. Rund 120 Spezialisten unter einem Dach entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben Reinigungs- und Pflegeprodukte. Am Standort Memmingen werden alle Buzil- und Planta-Produkte hergestellt, gelagert und kommissioniert. Unsere Produkte werden vor allem in der professionellen Gebäudereinigung geschätzt. title: Werkstudent:in (m/w/d) - Projektierung & Umsetzung, Batteriespeicher (BESS)
description:
Du studierst Elektrotechnik oder Energietechnik und willst an echten Industriespeicher-Projekten arbeiten statt an Übungsaufgaben? Dann lies weiter. 🔋

⚡ ÜBER FION

Die europäische Industrie verliert an Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, weil Strom hier teurer und volatiler ist als in den USA oder China. Der Grund: Erneuerbare schwanken stark – Fabriken verbrauchen konstant.

Wir lösen dieses Ungleichgewicht: FION plant und installiert für Industriestandorte das passende Batteriesystem und steuert es mit KI in Echtzeit über Tarife und Märkte. Das Ergebnis: deutlich niedrigere Energiekosten und messbare CO₂-Einsparungen. Wir arbeiten bereits mit mehreren Industrieunternehmen zusammen und werden von Early-Stage-Investoren unterstützt.

🎯 DEINE ROLLE

Unser Projektportfolio wächst schnell – und mit ihm die Projektierungs- und Umsetzungsarbeit-Arbeit hinter jedem Batteriespeicherprojekt: Planung, Netzanschluss, Dokumentation, Tools. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Delivery & Operations Lead und hältst den Projektbetrieb mit am Laufen – mit echter Verantwortung ab Tag 1.

Du siehst dabei den kompletten Lebenszyklus eines Industriespeicherprojekts: von der Auslegung über den Netzanschluss bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

Aufgaben

✅ Planung & Auslegung von BESS-Projekten: Aufstellpläne, technische Zeichnungen, Dimensionierung von Komponenten (Kabel, Schutztechnik, NA-Schutz)

✅ Mitarbeit an Netzanschlussanträgen nach VDE-AR-N 4110 (u. a. E.1/E.8-Formulare) – du lernst den kompletten Prozess von innen kennen

✅ Pflege von CRM (Pipedrive) und Projektmanagement, Dokumentation in Notion

✅ Recherche & Aufbereitung von Normen (VDE-AR-N, IEC) und Industrie-Trends

✅ Planungstools und Vorlagen mit aufbauen (z. B. Pläne-Automatisierung, Formular-Workflows) – deine Ideen fließen direkt ein

✅ Optional: Erstansprache von Elektrofachbetrieben für Projektins

title: Werkstudent HR (m/w/d)
description:
Die Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine 100 %ige Tochter der Daikin Chemical Europe GmbH und damit der Daikin Industries Ltd., mit Sitz in Osaka Japan, zugehörig. Die Daikin Gruppe mit weltweit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern ist ein führender Hersteller von Klima- und Kühlgeräten sowie von fluorhaltigen Chemikalien. Neben einer Anlage zur Feindestillation des Pharma-Treibmittels S227 Pharma, welches weltweit in Dosier-Aerosolen für die Verabreichung medizinischer Wirkstoffe (e.g. Sprays gegen Asthma und COPD) eingesetzt wird, betreibt Daikin seit 2020 auch eine Aufbereitungsanlage zur Reinigung rückgewonnener fluorierter technischer Gase (HFKW), so dass diese anschließend erneut zum Einsatz in Klima- und Kühlgeräten eingesetzt werden können. Zudem verfügt der Standort über eine thermische Spaltanlage zur schadlosen Entsorgung von FCKW, HFKW und FKW. Mittels Wasserstoff-Sauerstoffflamme werden die Gase in Spaltreaktoren zu Fluss- und Salzsäure umgewandelt und als Rohstoffe wieder in den Wertstoffkreislauf zurückgeführt.

  • Personalentwicklung Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen und -prozessen.
  • Prozessdokumentation & Compliance: Unterstützung bei der schriftlichen Ausarbeitung und Optimierung von HR-Prozessen um Richtlinien und Vorgaben zu dokumentieren.
  • Support im Tagesgeschäft: Unterstützung des HR-Teams im operativen Alltag (bei Bedarf z. B. Unterstützung bei der Bewerberkorrespondenz).

Qualifikation
